decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent valve-system component for the same infrastructure customers, it is inexpensive to keep available and still fits the firm's main business well.
This bracket remains close to the firm's fabrication capabilities and project customer base, so the option value of keeping it exceeds the likely low cost of offering it.
A standard public waste bin is relatively distant from the pipeline-focused core business, and after several years its strategic fit and likely payoff appear too limited to justify keeping it.
Although outside the core, the waste-bin-with-ashtray line has some overlap with municipal buyers and enough remaining option value to justify keeping it a bit longer.
Standalone outdoor ashtrays are a peripheral niche with weaker fit than the firm's core and likely less promise than the related bin line, so resources are better redeployed.
